switch_err_invalid_format: That doesn't look like a Switch error code. Use `NNNN-NNNN` (e.g. `2168-0002`) or a hex value (e.g. `0x2A2`).
switch_err_unknown_code: It seems like this error code is unknown. You can check [switchbrew.org](<https://switchbrew.org/wiki/Error_codes>) for more information.
switch_err_to_hex_invalid: That doesn't follow the Nintendo Switch `NNNN-NNNN` format.
switch_hex_to_err_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid hex value.
switch_log_no_attachment: Reply to a message with a Ryujinx log file attached, or attach one directly to this command.
switch_log_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid Ryujinx log file.
switch_log_note_shader_cache_collision: Cache collision detected. Investigate possible shader cache issues
switch_log_note_dump_hash_error: Dump error detected. Investigate possible bad game/firmware dump issues
switch_log_note_shader_cache_corruption: Cache corruption detected. Investigate possible shader cache issues
switch_log_note_keys_outdated: Keys or firmware out of date, consider updating them
switch_log_note_file_permission_error: File permission error. Consider deleting the save directory and allowing Ryujinx to make a new one
switch_log_note_save_not_found: Save not found error. Consider starting the game without a save file or using a new save file
switch_log_note_missing_services: Consider enabling `Ignore Missing Services` in Ryujinx settings
switch_log_note_vulkan_out_of_memory: Consider enabling `Texture Recompression` in Ryujinx settings
switch_log_note_default_user_profile: Default user profile in use, consider creating a custom one
switch_log_note_intel_vulkan: Intel iGPU users should consider using the Vulkan graphics backend
switch_log_note_amd_vulkan: AMD GPU users should consider using the Vulkan graphics backend
switch_log_note_dummy_audio: Dummy audio backend, consider changing to SDL2 or OpenAL
switch_log_note_expand_ram: `Use alternative memory layout` should only be enabled for 4K mods
switch_log_note_software_memory_manager: `Software` setting in Memory Manager Mode will give slower performance than the default `Host unchecked` setting
switch_log_note_ignore_missing_services: `Ignore Missing Services` being enabled can cause instability
switch_log_note_vsync_disabled: V-Sync disabled can cause instability, like games running faster than intended or longer load times
switch_log_note_fs_integrity_disabled: Disabling file integrity checks may cause corrupted dumps to go undetected
switch_log_note_backend_threading_off: Graphics Backend Multithreading should be set to `Auto`
switch_log_note_custom_build: Custom builds are not officially supported
